title: Hormozi AI Skill: local Claude Code / Codex skill that searches 9,330 timestamped passages from 2,039 public Hormozi videos and writes a cited business diagnosis

tools.name: hormozi-ai-skill
tools.detail: git clone https://github.com/viclaranja/hormozi-ai-skill.git ; cd hormozi-ai-skill ; ./install.ps1 (Windows) or ./install.sh (macOS/Linux); installs skills /ask-hormozi and /hormozi-report into Claude Code and Codex

tools.name: Obsidian
tools.detail: README: can point hormozi-report at an Obsidian vault or notes folder instead of answering interview questions

claims: Free, runs entirely locally; 'the corpus never leaves it'
Searches 9,330 timestamped passages from 2,039 public MoreMozi YouTube videos; every claim linked to the exact second of the source video
Install is one command, takes a few minutes, ~400 MB download and 350 MB on disk; no Python needed up front (installer fetches 3.11/3.12; 3.13/3.14 don't work)

/hormozi-report asks one question at a time, runs 8-14 searches across the corpus (constraint, offer, acquisition, sales, delivery, team), then writes an HTML report to Documents/Hormozi Reports/ that works offline
Separates evidence from opinion; conflicts between passages are shown, not smoothed over
how_to_steps: Type /ask-hormozi for a quick sourced answer, or /hormozi-report for the full interview-then-report flow
Open the HTML report in Documents/Hormozi Reports/ and click citations to jump to the video timestamp
on_screen_only: Title card 'Steal Hormozi's playbook for Claude'; clip of Alex Hormozi
README header: 'Hormozi AI Skill -- A free, local business-diagnosis tool for Claude Code and Codex'

Repo files: CONTRIBUTING.md, DATA-RIGHTS.md, LICENSE, PRIVACY.md, README.md, RELEASE-CHECKS.md, SECURITY.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, install.ps1, install.sh, pyproject.toml, requirements.lock (3 weeks ago)

Skills table: ask-hormozi -- 'Ask a question, get sourced answers with timestamped links. Quick lookups.'; hormozi-report -- 'The full thing. Interviews you about your business, then writes a complete diagnosis as a browser dashboard.'
'Git, to clone this repo. Downloading the ZIP works too, but cloning is more reliable'
cta: Save, follow; link in bio for the free repo and install guide

relevance.why: A sourced, local business-advisor skill is directly useful for a solo founder pressure-testing offers and pricing for his apps; the evidence/opinion separation addresses hallucination worries.

implement_score.why: One clone + install script, ~400 MB. Run /hormozi-report once per product to get a cited diagnosis; cheap experiment with real upside. Review install.sh before running.
